title: Transitioning from Presumptive to Conclusive Land Titling in India
lead_author: Dr. Arvind Sharma (NITI Aayog Land Reforms Group)
empirical_finding: Guaranteed state land titles backed by a Title Indemnity Fund reduce civil property litigations by 68% and unlock ₹14.2 Lakh Cr in dormant economic capital.
policy_recommendation: Enact State Conclusive Titling Bill with mandatory digital Cadastral Registry & Title Insurance Pool.

title: Socio-Economic Impact of Drone SVAMITVA & NAKSHA Surveys in Rural Habitats
lead_author: National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj (NIRDPR)
empirical_finding: Issuance of formal drone-delineated property cards increased rural formal bank agricultural collateral loans by 44% within 18 months.
policy_recommendation: Expand drone cadastral mapping to peri-urban abadi areas with automated e-Gram Swaraj linkage.

title: Land Value Capture (LVC) Mechanisms for Mass Urban Transit Corridors
lead_author: School of Planning and Architecture (SPA Delhi) & MoHUA
empirical_finding: Betterment levies and transferable development rights (TDR) around 3D ULPIN mapped transit stations can fund 35% of capital expenditure for metro lines.
policy_recommendation: Standardize Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) zoning with dynamic GIS betterment charges.
